mapper.sql: id, rule_name AS ruleName, event, model_code AS modelCode, conditions, actions, status, create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: select from fly_automation_rule order by create_time desc
select from fly_automation_rule where status = 1 and event = #{event}
select from fly_automation_rule where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into fly_automation_rule (id, rule_name, event, model_code, conditions, actions, status, create_time) values (#{id}, #{ruleName}, #{event}, #{modelCode}, #{conditions}, #{actions}, #{status}, now())
